title: Why Your Voice Sounds Weird On Recordings

scenes.say: Ever cringed at your own voice on a recording? There's a reason.
When you talk, you hear your own voice in two different ways.
Through the air, like everyone else. And through the bones in your skull.
scenes.heading: TWO PATHS

scenes.say: Your bones boost the low notes, so in your own head, you sound deeper and richer.
scenes.heading: IN YOUR HEAD

scenes.say: A recording only picks up the air. So it sounds higher, and thinner.
scenes.heading: ON A RECORDING

scenes.say: That shock even has a name: voice confrontation.
scenes.heading: IT HAS A NAME

scenes.say: And the twist? The recording is what everyone else hears. Every day.
scenes.heading: THE TWIST

scenes.say: Do you hate your recorded voice?
